fields.value: Good-looking, gentlemanlike, and immediately agreeable in manner.
Open, cheerful, sociable, modest, and too ready to defer to stronger judgments.
To enjoy company, act generously, and marry Jane once he trusts that his affection is returned.
A wealthy young man whose fortune comes from trade; rents Netherfield rather than owning an established estate.
Not stated precisely; a young adult.
Gentleman of independent fortune; tenant of Netherfield Park.
Jane’s suitor and a foil to Darcy in sociability and decisiveness.
Brother of Caroline Bingley and Louisa Hurst; close friend of Darcy.
Netherfield Park during the courtship; later an estate near Pemberley.
Moves from impressionable withdrawal to a renewed proposal made with greater confidence in his own judgment.
Jane: sincere love. Darcy: trusted friend whose influence first separates and later assists the couple. Caroline: affectionate but influenced brother.
